d: THE SIGNALBEARERS #3 — Velnara Prime Burning. The call comes at low tide: the Beacon Fields needs Thalthunee. Starring Thalthunee (Fahollow Quven), Tremara (Adine Qukem), Quodora (Odine Rilia), Maexor (Nebris Nefaro). A team of cosmic guardians keeps the beacon-network of the far colonies lit — and something out in the dark keeps trying to snuff it.
